bio: Darling, fashion is an art form, not an accident. Don't be boring.

nodes.partnerMessage: Darling {PlayerName}, thank goodness you matched. The fashion taste on this app is an absolute crime scene.

choices.choiceText: Are you offering fashion police protection?
Hey! My hoodie and sweatpants are peak comfort.

nodes.partnerMessage: Honey, I am the judge, jury, and stylist. But this chat is way too cramped for my commentary.

choices.choiceText: Where should we take this then?

nodes.partnerMessage: Sweatpants?! In public?! I need smelling salts immediately. We cannot discuss this here.

choices.choiceText: Fine, give me your handle on OnlyYaps.

nodes.partnerMessage: Tap my invite link below right now. The tea is boiling and I refuse to spill it here. 💅
